title: Harry Kane: Against the Odds
overview: From a quiet academy hopeful to one of football's most prolific strikers, this documentary traces Harry Kane's determined rise through setbacks, loan spells, and relentless self-belief. Blending personal interviews, unseen training-ground moments, and career-defining matches, it reveals how discipline, mentality, and leadership transformed him from an underestimated youngster into a global sporting icon.
